items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We stayed in touch constantly... So we started a little publishing company, many years ago, me and Archie.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. I was pretty good. Archie Moore once said – the man said, “If you stayed involved in boxing, you would have been the champion.” That’s what Archie said. I was pretty good at it.
How did you get to know Archie Moore?
